The assistant's response is unhelpful and inaccurate. It provides an incorrect general formula—the area of a triangle is not "1/2 the product of the lengths of the sides" (which would imply multiplying all three side lengths)—and it fails to apply any method to the given coordinates or provide the numerical answer. The correct area is 3 square units (calculable via the shoelace formula or by noting the right angle at the origin), which the assistant did not derive.
